episodes.synopsis: Kasuga Kyosuke moves to a new town and meets two unusual girl; we learn of his family's unusual gifts; and realize that it isn't easy being a cat.
episodes.title: A Transfer Student! 'Tis Embarrassing to Say, but I'll Fall in Love for the First Time

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke uses his powers when he shouldn't, and Hikaru becomes infatuated.  We are also introduced to the "legendary" Cutlet Sandwich.
episodes.title: A Little Lemony Kiss for Her

episodes.synopsis: Komatsu and Hatta lust after Kyosuke's sisters, and Kyosuke's plans to date Hikaru end up with him all wet.
episodes.title: Feelings Stirred - The Rolling First Date

episodes.synopsis: Rumors that Hikaru and Kyosuke have gone all the way set the school on fire. Needless to say, Madoka is not impressed.
episodes.title: Hikaru?! A Sensational "C" Experience!

episodes.synopsis: A chance encounter by Hikaru leads Kyosuke to believe that Madoka is having an affair with an older man, and when the truth is revealed, brings them closer.
episodes.title: A Secret for Two - A Problematic Part-Time Job

episodes.synopsis: Madoka tutors Kyosuke for some crucial exams, while a the same time Kyosuke tutors Hikaru.  Meanwhile, an angry young man wants Kyosuke's head for stealing his girl!
episodes.title: That Kid's My Rival - Midterm Exam of Love

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke gets concerned when it seems that Madoka is considerabley more "experienced" than he is.
episodes.title: Madoka's Private Life?! A Spark-Colored Kiss

episodes.synopsis: Hikaru is "discovered" by a photographer and gets a modeling job, but the trip to the beach to keep an eye on her has happy consequences for Kyosuke and Madoka.
episodes.title: You're Smiling! A "Shutter Chance" at the Beach

episodes.synopsis: When Kyosuke's sister Kurumi is apparently kidnapped, he learns a lot about his friends.
episodes.title: Kurumi, I'll Teach You How to Date

episodes.synopsis: A precognitive dream convinces Kyosuke that Hikaru is about to die, and when Hikaru learns of this, she decides to use his anxiety to get closer to him.
episodes.title: A Foreboding Dream?! Hikaru Is Dying

episodes.synopsis: Circumstances convince Kyosuke that Madoka is about to get married, resulting in a hilarious "The Graduate" parody ending.
episodes.title: Don't Ring the Wedding Bells!

episodes.synopsis: Madoka decides to move to America to be closer to her musician parents, sending all her friends into a panic.
episodes.title: Study Abroad in America! Goodbye Madoka!

episodes.synopsis: Kyosukes feelings for Madoka get wobbly when Hikaru gets a makeover that makes her look much more mature.
episodes.title: Everyone Is Looking! Hikaru's Super Transformation!

episodes.synopsis: Afraid of being looked down upon by Madoka as a wimp, Kyosuke overdoes it trying to quickly become a hunk.
episodes.title: A Foreboding Dream! Madoka and Kyosuke Are Breaking Up at Last!

episodes.synopsis: When Hikaru fears that Kyosuke has a new girlfriend, she turns to Madoka for advice on how to win him back!
episodes.title: Madoka's Ultimate Decision! Putting a Period to the Love Triangle

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke and Madoka see a UFO, but Kyosukes's reluctance to confirm her story lands him in the doghouse!
episodes.title: Well, Do You Believe or Not? Madoka Saw a UFO

episodes.synopsis: Durnng the summer break, Kyosuke makes two dates and finds himself frantically teleporting between Hikaru at the pool and Madoka at the library.
episodes.title: The Summer Temptation / A Double Date Out of the Blue

episodes.synopsis: A trip to the seashore ensnares everyone in a spooky mystery, and Madoka must challenge the legendary "Big Monday"!
episodes.title: Madoka's Challenge! The Haunted Beach Big Wave Legend

episodes.synopsis: Stranded on a deserted island, Kyosuke finds himself alone in paradise with Madoka!
episodes.title: The Couple's Experience / Forbidden Island of Love!

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi's "help" allows Kyosuke to excel at Tennis Camp, allowing him to get closer to Madoka.  Unfortunately, Hikaru sees him getting closer to Madoka...
episodes.title: Hikaru Witnesses! The Camp Is Full of Danger!

episodes.synopsis: While still at the tennis camp, Kyosuke gets into a compromising situation with another girl.  Madoka is not amused!
episodes.title: Kyosuke in a Pinch! Sweet Nothings at the Wuthering Heights!

episodes.synopsis: When Madoka suddenly vanishes, Kyosuke becomes concerned.  He becomes even more concerned when he sees her exiting a nightclub with another man!
episodes.title: An Adult Relationship? Madoka Secretly Returns Home in the Morning!

episodes.synopsis: Egos get in the way when Kyosuke and Madoka are chosen to represent their class in the big school marathon.
episodes.title: Kyosuke and Madoka in a Big Fight! The 3-Legged Race of Love!

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke's little cousin Kazuya arrives for a visit.  Unfortunately for Kyosuke, Kazuya is tuned into his brain waves and does everything he thinks!
episodes.title: Introducing Kazuya! Be Careful Around the Panic Kid!

episodes.synopsis: After being picked on by his family for being so indecisive, Kyosuke accidentally hypnotizes himself and becomes a confident ladies man.  How will he fare with Madoka, however?
episodes.title: Risky Self-Hypnosis! Kyosuke Changed!

episodes.synopsis: When Kyosuke learns that he can switch bodies with his little cousin Kazuya, he hatches a plot to use Kazuya's telepathic abilities to find out exactly what Madoka thinks about him!
episodes.title: Kyosuke Becomes a Kid! Getting Super-Close to Madoka!

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke tries to protect Madoka from a gang of tough girls, but it is Hikaru that winds up in their cross hairs!
episodes.title: Marked Woman Madoka! Kyosuke, Proving He's a Man!

episodes.synopsis: Manami changes her image with a glamorous makeover; only to get in trouble with some bad girls.  Kyosuke, in heroic disguise, tries to rescue the damsel in distress -- and neither knows who the other is!
episodes.title: Dangerous Decision! Manami's Big Adventure!

episodes.synopsis: Strange behavior by Jingoro leads to a frenzied quest to find a mate for the poor cat.  But what does Jingoro really want?
episodes.title: Don't Cry, Jingoro! The Heat of Young Love!

episodes.synopsis: Kurumi's first crush leads to chaos and confusion when Kyosuke discovers that the object of her desire wants Madoka instead!
episodes.title: A Tender Little Story / Kurumi's First Love, Chapter Hell!

episodes.synopsis: Yuusaku confesses his love for Madoka in front of Kyosuke, and soon the two are spending a lot of time together.  When they head off to a known "suicide mecca", Kyosuke assumes the worst!
episodes.title: Madoka and Yuusaku / The Marching Song of Runaway Youths

episodes.synopsis: When everyone forgets Kyosuke's birthday, he self-hypnotizes himself and becomes very untrusting.  Only his unreliable time-travel ability can get him out of the resulting jam!
episodes.title: Will My Birthday Come Twice? Time-Runner Kyosuke

episodes.synopsis: While out on a hiking trip, the gang discovers the legendary "Mushrooms of  Truth".  One bite, and you'll confess your innermost secrets...
episodes.title: Strange Madoka! The Mushroom of 120% Truth!

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke's grandparents invite the gang to visit them in the country, and drive Kyosuke up the wall because they aren't very careful about using their powers!
episodes.title: Roots Panic! Madoka in the Mysterious Homeland

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke is hypnotized by Kurumi and commanded to be obedient, only to end up becoming Hatta and Komatsu's slave.  Discovering the hold they have over him, the two perverts order Kyosuke to get nude pictures of Madoka!
episodes.title: Perverted With a Camera! Robo-Kyosuke!

episodes.synopsis: When Komatsu and Hatta accidentally witness Kyosuke teleporting, they use the student film they are making as a vehicle to try and expose him!
episodes.title: Adios, Kyosuke! Paranormal Powers Caught on Video!

episodes.synopsis: Madoka's past comes back to haunt her when she helps out an old friend, and ends up in a duel with a gang leader!
episodes.title: Heroic Orange Legend / Madoka's Duel in the Blizzard

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke's unreliable time traveling ability gets put to the test as he repeats a day several times, each time trying to make things better...
episodes.title: Kyosuke Timetrips! The Third Christmas

episodes.synopsis: When Kyosuke tries to hypnotize Madoka as a joke, he ends up actually doing it.  Now Madoka will do anything he wants... anything at all!
episodes.title: Hypnotizing Madoka / Kyosuke's Dangerous New Year

episodes.synopsis: New Year's Special.  The KOR characters play various roles in this parody of "Top Gun" and Toho monster films.
episodes.title: First Dream of the New Year / Giant Monster Jingoro's Counterattack

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke's grandfather hands him a pocket watch that allows him to actually stop time - for normal human beings!  But using it too much is so very tempting...
episodes.title: Immobilized Madoka / Kyosuke's Mysterious Watch

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke has a real problem when a young girl named Sumire gets a crush... on Madoka!
episodes.title: Madoka the Popular / Kyosuke Finally Confesses

episodes.synopsis: Hikaru is crushed to learn that Kyosuke and Yukari spent the night together.  Of course, they didn't actually do anything wrong, but...
episodes.title: Heartbroken Hikaru / Follow Her to the Winter Beach

episodes.synopsis: Kazuya ambushes Kyosuke and switches bodies with him, so that Kyosuke will have to go to the dentist in his place.  The sweet-toothed Kazyua, in Kyosuke's body, is out to get all the Valentine's Day chocolate he can!
episodes.title: The Taste of Love? Kyosuke's Valentine From Hell!

episodes.synopsis: Kyosuke wishes that Hikaru would get sick so he could spend more time with Madoka.  He gets his wish and then some... Hikaru's dead!
episodes.title: Goodbye Hikaru / And Then There Were None

episodes.synopsis: Trapped in a gondola, and with his powers exhausted; Kyosuke must try to keep himself and Madoka from freezing to death!
episodes.title: One Snow-White Night / Two Alone in a Gondola

episodes.synopsis: When Madoka tells Kyosuke about an old promise; that she'd vowed 6 years ago to meet someone again on this very day, Kyosuke travels back in time to find out who her "first love" was.
episodes.title: A Presentiment of Farewells - Find Madoka's First Love

episodes.synopsis: Madoka's father has fallen ill, and she must leave Japan to visit him.  Unable to find Kyosuke in order to say good-bye, Kyosuke's grandfather "helpfully" sends her back in time 6 years to where Kyosuke is now and was then!
episodes.title: I Found Love! and Da Capo
